source_refs.note: Exercise 9.2, Question 9 (book p. 273); the book prints no answers for Exercise 9.2; answers checked with sympy and the solution book

blocks.explanation:
Chaar \(\tan^{-1}\) terms hain, do plus aur do minus, aur jawab \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) hai.
Diya kya hai? \(\tan^{-1}\frac{10}{3}\), \(\tan^{-1}\frac{7}{13}\), \(\tan^{-1}\frac{9}{5}\), \(\tan^{-1}\frac{2}{7}\).
Find kya karna hai? Poora expression \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) dikhana hai.
Rule kaunsa? Farq wala formula (vi), do dafa.
Plan: terms ko do joron mein baanto: (pehla - doosra) aur (teesra - chautha). Agar har jora \(\frac{\pi}{4}\) de to kul \(\frac{\pi}{2}\).
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\tan^{-1}\frac{10}{3} - \tan^{-1}\frac{7}{13} + \tan^{-1}\frac{9}{5} - \tan^{-1}\frac{2}{7}\).
Maloom karna (prove): yeh \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) ke barabar hai.
Tareeqa: chaar terms ko do farq wale joron mein baant kar har jore par formula (vi) \(\tan^{-1}x - \tan^{-1}y = \tan^{-1}\frac{x-y}{1+xy}\) lagayenge. Is ki shart \(xy > -1\) hai, jo poori hai kyunke sab numbers positive hain. Jore chunna samajhdari ka kaam hai: (pehla, doosra) aur (teesra, chautha) dono saaf \(\tan^{-1}1\) dete hain.

Pehla jora
\[\tan^{-1}\tfrac{10}{3} - \tan^{-1}\tfrac{7}{13}\]
\[= \tan^{-1}\dfrac{\frac{10}{3} - \frac{7}{13}}{1 + \frac{10}{3}\cdot\frac{7}{13}}\]
\[= \tan^{-1}\dfrac{(130 - 21)/39}{(39 + 70)/39}\]
\[= \tan^{-1}\tfrac{109}{109} = \tan^{-1}1 = \tfrac{\pi}{4}\]
Kyun: common denominator \(3 \times 13 = 39\). Upar: \(10 \times 13 = 130\) aur \(7 \times 3 = 21\), farq 109. Neeche: \(1 = \frac{39}{39}\) aur \(10 \times 7 = 70\), jama 109. Barabar, to fraction 1.
Dhyan dein: farq ke formula mein neeche plus hai, minus nahi.

Doosra jora
\[\tan^{-1}\tfrac{9}{5} - \tan^{-1}\tfrac{2}{7}\]
\[= \tan^{-1}\dfrac{\frac{9}{5} - \frac{2}{7}}{1 + \frac{9}{5}\cdot\frac{2}{7}}\]
\[= \tan^{-1}\dfrac{(63 - 10)/35}{(35 + 18)/35}\]
\[= \tan^{-1}\tfrac{53}{53} = \tan^{-1}1 = \tfrac{\pi}{4}\]
Kyun: common denominator \(5 \times 7 = 35\). Upar: \(9 \times 7 = 63\) aur \(2 \times 5 = 10\), farq 53. Neeche: \(35 + 18 = 53\). Phir fraction 1.

Dono jore jama karein
\[\text{L.H.S} = \tfrac{\pi}{4} + \tfrac{\pi}{4} = \tfrac{\pi}{2} = \text{R.H.S}\]
Kyun: poora expression (pehla jora) + (doosra jora) hai, aur dono \(\frac{\pi}{4}\) hain.
Agar aap terms ko kisi aur tarah jorte, masalan (pehla, teesra) aur (doosra, chautha), to bhi jawab \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) hi aata, lekin hisaab bohat lamba aur jama wale formula ki shart \(xy < 1\) bhi toot jati (\(\frac{10}{3} \cdot \frac{9}{5} = 6 > 1\)). Is liye jore soch samajh kar chuniye.

Tasdeeq
\[1.2793 - 0.4939 + 1.0637 - 0.2783\]
\[= 1.5708 \approx \tfrac{\pi}{2}\ \checkmark\]
Kyun: calculator (radian mode) se chaaron angles ka hisaab \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) deta hai.
Yeh tasdeeq is liye bhi achhi hai ke chaar terms mein sign ki ghalti ka khatra zyada hota hai.
